revenue-sync demo, the real CLI on stand-ins for Stripe and HubSpot.
No keys, nothing leaves this machine. Key lines of each step shown.

$ node bin/revenue-sync.mjs seed --hubspot
Created 10 HubSpot companies.
exit 0
$ node bin/revenue-sync.mjs sync --usage usage.csv
Wrote 71 values to HubSpot.
exit 0

$ node bin/revenue-sync.mjs plan --usage usage.csv
Northwind Analytics (HubSpot 100)

  rs_seat_count: 30 → 25 (edited in HubSpot since the last sync)
2 writes across 1 company.
exit 0
$ node bin/revenue-sync.mjs sync --usage usage.csv
